note: The textbook case in this batch and the closest match to the ICP as stated. Busy professional running at full tilt at work, no affordability resistance at all — he treats $4,000-$6,000 as the normal band for this category — and health is precisely the lagging area rather than a crisis: 'I want my physical body to match the levels that I've attained on the other side of the fence.' That is 'good, wanting to go from good to great' almost verbatim. He is nowhere near the excluded profile: 190 lb at 5'10", 100 snowboard days a year, daily deep squats, eats single-ingredient whole foods, no injuries and no limitations. The finding worth carrying to the rollup is that the one core-ICP prospect in this batch did not close, and not for any reason the ICP screens for — he left because the offer read as undifferentiated at the top of the market band and because the call itself, in his words, was awkward.
